```{r}
# Plotting and exploration
ggplot(trim_summed_subsets, aes(x=reorder(cAb, -rank), y=rank))+
  geom_bar(stat='identity')+
  facet_wrap(~dAb, scales = 'free')

raw_subsets %>% group_by(dAb, cAb) %>% summarise(across(Importance, mean)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=reorder(cAb, Importance), y=Importance))+
  geom_bar(stat='identity')+
  facet_wrap(~dAb, scales = 'free')+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          angle = 45,
          vjust=1,
          hjust=1
        ))
summed_subsets_scaled = summed_subsets %>% 
  group_by(dAb) %>% 
  mutate(scaled_rank = rank/max(rank))
summed_subsets_scaled
ggplot(summed_subsets_scaled, aes(x=dAb, y=cAb, fill = scaled_rank))+
  geom_tile(color = "white")+
  theme_classic()+
  labs(x = "Detection Antibody",
       y = "Capture Antibody",
       title = "Antibody Importance Across Feature selection Methods",
       subtitle = "Scaled Rank of Capture and Detection Pairs",
       fill = "Scaled Rank")+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          angle = 45,
          vjust=1,
          hjust=1
        ),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold'))+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = "#012169")

ggsave("subset_heatmap.png", device = "png", dpi = 1000)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# Naive Bayes
nb_control_function = function(df,
                               target,
                               k1,
                               num_repeats,
                               subset=T,
                               subset_size=0,
                               subset_df){
  cl = makeCluster(6)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  performance_df = NULL
  
  clean_df = df %>% select(-c(Conc., Replicates))
  
  if (subset == T){
  # Get dab name from df
    dab_name = regexpr("dAb\\d{1,2}(?=_)", colnames(df), perl = T)
    dab_name = unique(regmatches(colnames(df), dab_name))
  
    importance_df = subset_df %>% filter(dAb == dab_name)
    important_cabs = importance_df$cAb
  
    important_pairs = paste(dab_name,"_",important_cabs, sep='')
    downselect_df = clean_df %>% select(target, important_pairs[1:subset_size])
  }
  else{
    downselect_df = clean_df
  }
  # Create initial folds
  global_folds = createFolds(downselect_df[[target]], k=k1)
  
  model_matrix_formula = paste(target, "~", ".") %>% as.formula()
  
  train_control = trainControl(method = 'repeatedcv',
                               number = 5,
                               repeats = 3)
  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
    for (fold in 1:k1){
      train = downselect_df[-global_folds[[fold]],]
      test = downselect_df[global_folds[[fold]],]
      
      preprocess = preProcess(train, method = c('center','scale'))
      train = predict(preprocess, train)
      test = predict(preprocess, test)
  
      x_train = train %>% select(-target)
      y_train = train[[target]]
      
      x_test = test %>% select(-target)
      y_test = test[[target]]
      
      cv_model = train(model_matrix_formula,
                       data = train,
                       method = 'ta_nb',
                       tuneLength = 20,
                       trControl = train_control)
      
      opt_predict = predict(cv_model$finalModel, x_test,
                            type = 'class')
      opt_predict = opt_predict$class %>% as.factor()
      
      
      perf_call = get_rf_performance(opt_predict, y_test)

      if (is.null(performance_df)){
        performance_df = perf_call$perf_metrics
      }
      else{
        performance_df = bind_rows(performance_df, perf_call$perf_metrics)
      }
    }
  }
  return(performance_df)
}
```

```{r}
ta_nb_control_function = function(df,
                               target,
                               k1,
                               num_repeats,
                               subset=T,
                               subset_size=0,
                               subset_df){
  cl = makeCluster(6)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  performance_df = NULL
  
  clean_df = df %>% select(-c(Conc., Replicates))
  
  if (subset == T){
  # Get dab name from df
    dab_name = regexpr("dAb\\d{1,2}(?=_)", colnames(df), perl = T)
    dab_name = unique(regmatches(colnames(df), dab_name))
  
    importance_df = subset_df %>% filter(dAb == dab_name)
    important_cabs = importance_df$cAb
  
    important_pairs = paste(dab_name,"_",important_cabs, sep='')
    downselect_df = clean_df %>% select(target, important_pairs[1:subset_size])
  }
  else{
    downselect_df = clean_df
  }
  # Create initial folds
  global_folds = createFolds(downselect_df[[target]], k=k1)
  
  model_matrix_formula = paste(target, "~", ".") %>% as.formula()
  
  train_control = trainControl(method = 'repeatedcv',
                               number = 5,
                               repeats = 3,
                               classProbs = T)
  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
    for (fold in 1:k1){
      train = downselect_df[-global_folds[[fold]],]
      test = downselect_df[global_folds[[fold]],]
      
      preprocess = preProcess(train, method = c('center','scale'))
      train = predict(preprocess, train)
      test = predict(preprocess, test)
  
      x_train = train %>% select(-target)
      y_train = train[[target]]
      
      x_test = test %>% select(-target)
      y_test = test[[target]]
      
      cv_model = train(x=x_train,
                       y=y_train,
                       data = train,
                       method = 'tanSearch',
                       tuneLength = 20,
                       trControl = train_control)
      
      opt_predict = predict(cv_model$finalModel, x_test,
                            type = 'class')
      opt_predict = opt_predict$class %>% as.factor()
      
      
      perf_call = get_rf_performance(opt_predict, y_test)

      if (is.null(performance_df)){
        performance_df = perf_call$perf_metrics
      }
      else{
        performance_df = bind_rows(performance_df, perf_call$perf_metrics)
      }
    }
  }
  return(performance_df)
}
```

```{r}
# XgBoost
xgb_control_function = function(df,
                               target,
                               k1,
                               num_repeats){
  cl = makeCluster(6)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  performance_df = NULL
  
  clean_df = df %>% select(-c(Conc., Replicates))
  
  dab_name = regexpr("dAb\\d{1,2}(?=_)", colnames(df), perl = T)
  dab_name = unique(regmatches(colnames(df), dab_name))

  importance_df = trim_summed_subsets %>% filter(dAb == dab_name)
  important_cabs = importance_df$cAb

  important_pairs = paste(dab_name,"_",important_cabs, sep='')
  downselect_df = clean_df %>% select(target, important_pairs[1:10])
  
  # Create initial folds
  global_folds = createFolds(downselect_df[[target]], k=k1)
  
  model_matrix_formula = paste(target, "~", ".") %>% as.formula()
  
  train_control = trainControl(method = 'adaptive_cv',
                               number = 5,
                               repeats = 3,
                               adaptive = list(min=5, alpha = 0.05,
                                               method = 'gls', complete = T),
                               search = 'random')
  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
    for (fold in 1:k1){
      train = downselect_df[-global_folds[[fold]],]
      test = downselect_df[global_folds[[fold]],]
      
      preprocess = preProcess(train, method = c('center','scale'))
      train = predict(preprocess, train)
      test = predict(preprocess, test)
  
      x_train = train %>% select(-target)
      y_train = train[[target]]
      
      x_test = test %>% select(-target)
      y_test = test[[target]]
      
      cv_model = train(model_matrix_formula,
                       data = train,
                       method = 'xgbTree',
                       tuneLength = 15,
                       trControl = train_control,
                       metric = 'Kappa')
      
      opt_predict = predict(cv_model, x_test,
                            type = 'raw')

      opt_predict = opt_predict %>% as.factor()
      
      
      perf_call = get_rf_performance(opt_predict, y_test)

      if (is.null(performance_df)){
        performance_df = perf_call$perf_metrics
      }
      else{
        performance_df = bind_rows(performance_df, perf_call$perf_metrics)
      }
    }
  }
  return(performance_df)
}
```

```{r}
rad_svm_control_function = function(df,
                               target,
                               k1,
                               num_repeats,
                               subset=T,
                               subset_size=0,
                               subset_df){
  cl = makeCluster(6)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  performance_df = NULL
  
  clean_df = df %>% select(-c(Conc., Replicates))
  
  if (subset == T){
  # Get dab name from df
    dab_name = regexpr("dAb\\d{1,2}(?=_)", colnames(df), perl = T)
    dab_name = unique(regmatches(colnames(df), dab_name))

    downselect_df = clean_df %>% select(target, important_pairs[1:subset_size])
  }
  else{

  }
  # Create initial folds
  global_folds = createFolds(downselect_df[[target]], k=k1)
  
  model_matrix_formula = paste(target, "~", ".") %>% as.formula()

  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
```

```{r}
rf_subset_control_function = function(df,
                               target,
                               k1,
                               num_repeats,
                               subset=T,
                               subset_size=0,
                               subset_df){
  cl = makeCluster(6)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  performance_df = NULL
  
  clean_df = df %>% select(-c(Conc., Replicates))
  
  if (subset == T){
  # Get dab name from df
    dab_name = regexpr("dAb\\d{1,2}(?=_)", colnames(df), perl = T)
    dab_name = unique(regmatches(colnames(df), dab_name))
  
    importance_df = subset_df %>% filter(dAb == dab_name)
    important_cabs = importance_df$cAb
  
    important_pairs = paste(dab_name,"_",important_cabs, sep='')
    downselect_df = clean_df %>% select(target, important_pairs[1:subset_size])
  }
  else{
    downselect_df = clean_df
  }

  # Create initial folds
  global_folds = createFolds(downselect_df[[target]], k=k1)
  
  model_matrix_formula = paste(target, "~", ".") %>% as.formula()
  
  train_control = trainControl(method = 'repeatedcv',
                               number = 5,
                               repeats = 3,
                               classProbs = T)
  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
    for (fold in 1:k1){
      train = downselect_df[-global_folds[[fold]],]
      test = downselect_df[global_folds[[fold]],]
      
      preprocess = preProcess(train, method = c('center','scale'))
      train = predict(preprocess, train)
      test = predict(preprocess, test)
  
      x_train = train %>% select(-target)
      y_train = train[[target]]
      
      x_test = test %>% select(-target)
      y_test = test[[target]]
      cv_model = train(model_matrix_formula,
                       data = train,
                       method = 'ranger',
                       trControl = train_control,
                       tuneLength = 25,
                       metric = 'Accuracy')
      
      opt_predict = predict(cv_model, x_test,
                            type = 'raw')

      opt_predict = opt_predict %>% as.factor()
      
      
      perf_call = get_rf_performance(opt_predict, y_test)

      if (is.null(performance_df)){
        performance_df = perf_call$perf_metrics
      }
      else{
        performance_df = bind_rows(performance_df, perf_call$perf_metrics)
      }
    }
  }
  print(performance_df)
  return(performance_df)
}
```

```{r}
                               target,

  cl = makeCluster(6)
  registerDoParallel(cl)

  # Get dab name from df
```

```{r}
    downselect_df = clean_df %>% select(target, important_pairs[1:subset_size])
  }
  else{
    downselect_df = clean_df
  }

  # Create initial folds
  global_folds = createFolds(downselect_df[[target]], k=k1)
  
  model_matrix_formula = paste(target, "~", ".") %>% as.formula()
  
  train_control = trainControl(method = 'repeatedcv',
                               number = 5,
                               repeats = 3,
                               classProbs = T)
  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
    for (fold in 1:k1){

      x_test = test %>% select(-target)

      cv_model = train(model_matrix_formula,
                       data = train,

      }
    }
  }
  print(performance_df)

}
```

```{r}
                                                model_type ='lda',
                                                subset_bool = F)

all_lda_10_subset = subset_model_call_loop(df_list = trimmed_dab_df_list,
                                          model_type = 'lda',
                                          subset = T,
                                          subset_size = 10,
                                          subset_df = trim_summed_subsets)
all_lda_5_subset = subset_model_call_loop(df_list = trimmed_dab_df_list,
                                         model_type = 'lda',
                                         subset_bool = T,
                                         subset_size = 5,
                                         subset_df = trim_summed_small_subset)


original_lda_acc = mean(lda_original$accuracy)
original_lda_kap = mean(lda_original$kappa)
original_lda_acc
original_lda_kap

all_lda_accs = sapply(all_lda_original_subset, get_acc)
all_lda_kap = sapply(all_lda_original_subset, get_kap)
all_lda_accs
all_lda_kap

large_subset_lda_acc = sapply(all_lda_10_subset, get_acc)
large_subset_lda_kappa = sapply(all_lda_10_subset, get_kap)
large_subset_lda_acc
large_subset_lda_kappa

small_subset_lda_acc = sapply(all_lda_5_subset, get_acc)
small_subset_lda_kap = sapply(all_lda_5_subset, get_kap)
small_subset_lda_acc
small_subset_lda_kap
```

```{r}
subset_model_call_loop = function(df_list,
                                  model_type,
                                  k1 = 5,
                                  num_repeats = 5,
                                  subset_bool = TRUE,
                                  subset_size = 10,
                                  subset_df = NULL){
  cl = makeCluster(6)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  result_list = list()
  
  if (model_type == 'nb'){
    for (df in df_list){
      print(df)
      result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] = nb_control_function(df = df,
                                                                   target = "target_vector",
                                                                   k1 = k1,
                                                                   num_repeats = num_repeats,
                                                                   subset = subset_bool,
                                                                   subset_size = subset_size,
                                                                   subset_df = subset_df)
    }
  }
  if (model_type == 'ta_nb'){
    for (df in df_list){
      print(df)
      result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] = ta_nb_control_function(df = df,
                                                                   target = "target_vector",
                                                                   k1 = k1,
                                                                   num_repeats = num_repeats,
                                                                   subset = subset_bool,
                                                                   subset_size = subset_size,
                                                                   subset_df = subset_df)
    }
  }
  if (model_type == 'xgb'){
    for (df in df_list){
      print(df)
      result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] = xgb_control_function(df = df,
                                                                   target = "target_vector",
                                                                   k1 = k1,
                                                                   num_repeats = num_repeats,
                                                                   subset = subset_bool,
                                                                   subset_size = subset_size,
                                                                   subset_df = subset_df)
    }
  }
  if (model_type == 'lda'){
    for (df in df_list){
      print(df)
      result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] = lda_control_function(df = df,
                                                                   target = "target_vector",
                                                                   k1 = k1,
                                                                   num_repeats = num_repeats,
                                                                   subset = subset_bool,
                                                                   subset_size = subset_size,
                                                                   subset_df = subset_df)
    }
  }
  if (model_type == 'svm'){
    for (df in df_list){
      print(df)
      result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] = svm_control_function(df = df,
                                                                   target = "target_vector",
                                                                   k1 = k1,
                                                                   num_repeats = num_repeats,
                                                                   subset = subset_bool,
                                                                   subset_size = subset_size,
                                                                   subset_df = subset_df)
    }
  }
  
  if (model_type == 'radSvm'){
    for (df in df_list){
      print(df)
      result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] = rad_svm_control_function(df = df,
                                                                   target = "target_vector",
                                                                   k1 = k1,
                                                                   num_repeats = num_repeats,
                                                                   subset = subset_bool,
                                                                   subset_size = subset_size,
                                                                   subset_df = subset_df)
    }
  }
  
  if (model_type == 'polySvm'){
    for (df in df_list){
      print(df)
      result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] = poly_svm_control_function(df = df,
                                                                   target = "target_vector",
                                                                   k1 = k1,
                                                                   num_repeats = num_repeats,
                                                                   subset = subset_bool,
                                                                   subset_size = subset_size,
                                                                   subset_df = subset_df)
    }
  }
  
  if (model_type == 'gamboost'){
    for (df in df_list){
      print(df)
      result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] = gam_boost_control_function(df = df,
                                                                   target = "target_vector",
                                                                   k1 = k1,
                                                                   num_repeats = num_repeats,
                                                                   subset = subset_bool,
                                                                   subset_size = subset_size,
                                                                   subset_df = subset_df)
    }
    }
  
  if (model_type == 'rf'){
    for (df in df_list){
      print(df)
      result_list[[length(result_list) + 1]] = rf_subset_control_function(df = df,
                                                                   target = "target_vector",
                                                                   k1 = k1,
                                                                   num_repeats = num_repeats,
                                                                   subset = subset_bool,
                                                                   subset_size = subset_size,
                                                                   subset_df = subset_df)
    }
  }
  
  stopCluster(cl)
  registerDoSEQ()
  
  return(result_list)
}
```

```{r}
results = read.csv("pair_subset_results/subset_model_results.csv", stringsAsFactors = T)
levels(results$Feature_subset) = c("Original", "Unselected", "Top10", "Top5")

results_plot = ggplot(results, aes(x=Model, y=Accuracy, fill = Feature_subset))+
  geom_bar(stat='identity', position = 'dodge', color = 'black')+
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Accuracy-std.err, ymax = Accuracy+std.err),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(0.9)
  )+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14,
                              face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14,
                                face = "bold")) +
      labs(y = "Average Accuracy",
           x = "Type of model",
           fill = "Feature Subset") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#90B4CB", "#206a95", "#005587", "#21396F")
      )+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), breaks=c(.2,.4,.6,.8,1), limits=c(0,1))

results_plot
ggsave("subset_model_results.png", results_plot, device = "png", dpi = 1000)
```
